content_sections.text: The recruitment offers a total of 208 vacancies distributed across various Child Development Projects (Blocks) in Kasganj district. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Gender: Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the Anganwadi Worker position. Residence: The applicant must be a permanent resident of the same Gram Sabha (for rural areas) or Ward (for urban areas) where the vacancy exists. Educational Qualification: The minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (Class 12) or its equivalent from a recognized board. The maximum educational qualification considered for merit is up to Post-Graduation. Age Limit: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years as on 1 July 2026. Income Criteria & Priorities: Preference is given to widows, legally divorced women, and abandoned women living below the poverty line within the same Gram Sabha/Ward. If no such candidate is available, candidates from families living below the poverty line in the same Gram Sabha/Ward are considered. Subsequent priorities apply to higher income brackets if BPL candidates are not found.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is carried out through a direct recruitment process based on merit. The merit list is prepared according to the percentage of marks obtained in educational qualifications ranging from High School up to Post-Graduation. Candidates must submit their online applications and cross-verify their printouts with original documents during verification.

Upload self-attested copies of required documents, certificates, and photographs as specified in the online portal. Submit the completed application form online on or before 4 November 2026. Take a printout of the submitted application form and match all entries with your original documents for discrepancy checking.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in UP Kasganj Anganwadi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 208 vacancies have been announced for Anganwadi Worker posts across various blocks in Kasganj district.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for UP Kasganj Anganwadi Worker posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 4 November 2026 by midnight 12:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Intermediate (Class 12) or an equivalent examination as the minimum qualification, with merit assessed up to Post-Graduation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 years and 35 years of age as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the same Gram Sabha or Ward where the vacancy is located are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for UP Kasganj Anganwadi Recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any application fee amount for submitting the online form.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared according to the candidate's educational qualifications from High School up to Post-Graduation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the official website to submit applications?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official website at upanganwadibharti.in.
